descriptors.concept_name: Availability of a Refund or Reduction in Future Contributions
descriptors.definition: An entity evaluates economic benefits from a plan surplus as a refund or reduced future contributions based on plan terms and statutory rules. The maximum available benefit must be determined without mutually exclusive assumptions or reliance on uncertain future events outside the entity's control.
inclusion: economic benefits realizable during plan life or upon settlement
refunds based on gradual or full settlement of plan liabilities
exclusion: surplus refunds dependent on uncertain future events outside entity control
mutually exclusive combinations of refunds and contribution reductions
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from standard post-employment liability measurements by focusing strictly on the asset ceiling limits and realizable surplus conditions.

descriptors.concept_name: EXTRACTS OF FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OF LISTED ENTITY
descriptors.definition: Reporting entities disclose specific accounting policies for employee benefits encompassing short-term compensation, defined contribution plans, and defined benefit plans. Obligations for defined benefit gratuity plans are actuarially measured using the projected unit credit method with re-measurements routed through other comprehensive income.
inclusion: gratuity plan obligations and actuarial gains and losses
exclusion: unrecognized informal commitments outside established plan parameters
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from general provisions by applying specialized actuarial discounting and specific other comprehensive income recognition rules for post-employment benefits.

descriptors.concept_name: Significant Differences In Ind As 19 Vis-À-Vis As 15
descriptors.definition: Accounting frameworks diverge regarding employee benefit definitions, constructive obligations, and the timing of past service cost recognition. Ind AS 19 mandates immediate expense recognition for past service costs upon plan amendment or curtailment, unlike the amortized vesting approach in older standards.
inclusion: comparative criteria for employee definition including non-whole-time directors
related party disclosures for common control risk-sharing defined benefit plans
exclusion: straight-line amortization of past service cost over the average vesting period
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from AS 15 by eliminating the deferred amortization window for past service costs and explicitly broadening the definition of an employee.
